summary: Recorded in Washington, D.C. before the 2018 Unite the Right 2 counter-protest, this episode uses leaked chat logs to examine how post-2016 American fascist groups recruited online, hid their racism and planned violence.

evidence.note: Recorded on location in DC the day of the Unite the Right 2 counter-protest
Episode built on leaked chat logs of post-2016 far-right groups
Kessler introduced as the figure embodying the first wave; his rally planning follows
Anti-Com profiled as a rebranded far-right group, recurring through the episode
YouTube, gaming and GamerGate as radicalization and recruiting pipelines
Chats about explosives manuals and evading capture after a church shooting
Critique of media coverage that lets far-right leaders present themselves unchallenged
Panel discusses chanting, provocation and expectations for the counter-protest
Unite the Right planning begins June 2017; collapse of groups into 2018

notes: Format current-affairs: a field-recorded episode about the movement as it stood at release, not a historical deep dive. Kessler's 2009 graduation, Occupy 2011 and GamerGate 2014 are passing background, so covered_span starts 2016. Kessler's birth year 1983 is from general knowledge.
